title: Hirtenmakkeroni
description: A vegan interpretation of a simple mountain pasta dish.
steps: Clean the mushrooms, quarter them, and cook them in a pan.
Finely chop the onion and garlic and sauté them in oil in a separate pot. Crumble the tofu and add it.
Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions.
Add the passata, mushrooms, and seasoning to the pot. Stir in the coconut milk and simmer for about 15 minutes.
Stir in the macaroni, season to taste, and serve hot.
allergens: Depending on the products used, this may contain gluten and soy. Always check the ingredients.
